apps.name: Nightify
apps.subtitle: Your music, on every screen.
apps.localizedDescription:
Nightify for iPhone 0.1.7 fixes song search rows that could show a result label instead of the artist's name. Artist credits now handle multiple unlinked names and keep available artist identifiers.

Album rows that point to a music video or unavailable premium version can now play the matching song recording when title, artist and duration agree.

Icon controls remain accessible on older supported iOS versions, including password visibility and playlist download actions.
The guest-speaker option scrolls with sign-in content so it cannot cover the registration button when the keyboard is open.

Refresh the Nightify source in SideStore or AltStore and update in place using the same Apple signing account. Existing accounts, libraries, downloads and settings are retained.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Discover and pair with nearby Nightify speakers on your local network.
